blocks.body:
## Current verdict

Nimbo is **not ready to scale acquisition**. The August 29 public-rank goal is unmet; the iOS 1.0.1 crash still lacks a symbolicated diagnostic report; Open-Meteo promotion clearance is not attached; current phone vc8 and Apple build 6 are unsigned and have no matching signed physical QA; nimbo.uz is still waiting for registrar activation; and every critical weekly console guardrail remains unknown. The reported Play conversion is above target, but its denominator must be reconciled before it can support a decision.

## Operating rule

Unknown quality, provider, release identity, domain, or physical-device evidence is never converted into a pass. External UI side effects remain action-time gated by the execution surface, and the zero-budget boundary remains in force.

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · restore diagnostic access, symbolicate, fix, re-smoke
gate_snapshot.evidence: Authenticated App Store Connect confirms one iOS 1.0.1 crash on 2026-08-25, but privacy suppression exposes no device, OS, crash report, stack, or UUID. Xcode Organizer also reports that a developer account is required to download the crash list, so symbolication and root-cause verification remain blocked.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Restore Organizer developer-account access or obtain the diagnostic report, then symbolicate, reproduce, fix, and re-smoke

gate_snapshot.decision: PENDING · send clarification and record the answer
gate_snapshot.evidence: Clarification email is drafted but has not been sent or answered.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Send through an authenticated sender and record an unambiguous written response

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · sign and hash current vc8/build 6
gate_snapshot.evidence: Android phone 1.1.0 (8) and Apple 1.1.0 (6) are the current source identities, but the login Keychain is locked and neither current candidate has a signed artifact, immutable hash, or matching physical-QA evidence. Unchanged Wear OS 1.1.0 (1000008) alone remains verified-current.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Unlock the Keychain, create new signed vc8 and build-6 artifacts without overwriting history, verify identities and hashes, then record exact evidence

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · current signed vc8 and physical matrix missing
gate_snapshot.evidence: Current phone 1.1.0 (8) passed a bounded physical API 25 debug/source smoke for clean onboarding, live Tashkent weather, cached offline cold start, and stability, but it still has no upload-signed current artifact or matching release-certificate physical result. The signed vc7 matrix is historical and does not transfer to vc8; physical tablet, widget, and Wear OS coverage also remains required.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Sign and verify phone vc8, then run the exact signed artifact on phone and tablet plus widget and paired Wear OS paths

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · signed build 6 and physical matrix missing
gate_snapshot.evidence: Current Apple 1.1.0 (6) has only an unsigned arm64 simulator build and no distribution-signed archive, artifact hash, or physical result. The build-5 iPad install and build-4 bounded runtime evidence are historical and do not transfer; current iPhone, iPad, widget, and watch coverage remains required.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Archive and distribution-sign build 6, then run the exact artifact on iPhone and iPad plus widget and paired watch paths

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · registrar activation and registry delegation missing
gate_snapshot.evidence: The registrar surface reports nimbo.uz waiting for activation, registry WHOIS reports EXPIRED with creation and expiration both 2026-08-28, and authoritative plus public resolvers return DNSSEC NXDOMAIN. GitHub Pages is healthy, but registry delegation and TLS cannot proceed until registrar activation is complete.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Complete registrar activation, then verify registry delegation, publish the reviewed Cloudflare DNS records, and wait for valid HTTPS

gate_snapshot.decision: PASS · no open policy action in the 2026-08-28 read-only check
gate_snapshot.evidence: Read-only 2026-08-28 console check found no open App Store review/compliance action and Google Play Policy status explicitly reported no issues; see growth/quality/store-policy-console-2026-08-28.md.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Re-check both store policy surfaces with the next weekly UZ console evidence window

accessIssues.message: Raw App Store Connect and Play Console exports with country, source, device, version, and denominator definitions are not attached.

App Store Connect confirms one crash on iOS 1.0.1 on August 25, 2026, but exposes no stack trace at this traffic level; Xcode Organizer reports that a developer account is required to download the crash list.
Current Android phone vc8 and Apple build 6 have no signed artifacts, immutable hashes, or matching physical-QA evidence while the login Keychain is locked.
nimbo.uz is waiting for registrar activation and is registry-level NXDOMAIN; public DNS and TLS evidence cannot exist yet.
All eight critical console guardrails lack decision-eligible weekly evidence; unknown remains blocking even though the separate 2026-08-28 operational policy-console check passed.

query.description: Loads the complete required goal surfaces from the fixed public-rank capture while preserving bounded absences; one auxiliary Apple query is incomplete.
tables_used: inline rank values backed by growth/data/public-rank/2026-08-29.json

Google generic success requires Top-10 on at least two of three profiles for at least two queries
